title: MSO centennial concert features world premiere by Ryan Cayabyab
summary: The Manila Symphony Orchestra (MSO) will premiere a new work by National Artist for Music Ryan Cayabyab at its fifth centennial concert on October 22 at the Proscenium Theater in Makati City.
